primary_question: Does observable logistics information improve future U.S. manufactured-goods import-price forecasts beyond strong price-history and broad import/fuel price controls?
target: BLS Harmonized System manufactured import-price indexes; direct log price change
universe_rule: HS2, chapter >=28, BLS series begin_year <=2004; fuels/primary commodity targets excluded
estimator: standardized ridge regression; alpha tuned only on pre-2017 expanding folds then frozen
leakage_rule: At origin t, training examples only if target_end <= t
uncertainty: 6-month moving-block bootstrap over calendar months with all categories kept together
next_gate: Granular Census product/country/port/mode/charges/weight + PortWatch exposure must beat both baseline and GSCPI on untouched data.
